name: 前置摄像头近景自拍
description: 手持手机前置摄像头拍摄的大头或肩部特写自拍，带有微广角畸变与随手举拍感。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Raw candid front-facing iPhone selfie, 24mm wide-angle lens slight facial distortion, arm-length high-angle perspective, slightly tilted casual framing, close-up head and shoulders shot.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Natural skin texture with visible pores and minor imperfections, no beauty filter, uneven ambient lighting, slight handheld micro-blur, authentic unedited smartphone snapshot.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述面部表情、眼神方向及头部姿态（如直视镜头微微笑、略显疲惫地单手托腮）

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，描述贴近脸旁或手持举起的小物件（如一杯冰美式、刚拆开的快递盒）

environment_context.instruction: 描述身后局部背景及当前光线色温（如凌乱的卧室床头与台灯暖光、办公室格子间顶灯）

name: 镜面及反光介质自拍
description: 对着镜子、电梯金属门或玻璃橱窗拍摄的半身或全身自拍，手机必须真实入镜。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Candid mirror selfie shot on an iPhone rear camera, half-body to three-quarter reflection shot, holding a smartphone in one hand clearly visible in the reflection, casual off-center composition.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Subtle water spots, faint smudges and dust on mirror glass, realistic overhead indoor fluorescent or hallway lighting, slight ISO sensor grain, raw unedited mobile photo, zero studio lighting.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述站姿、握持手机的手势（如手机置于胸前、或微微遮挡下半张脸）及视线方向（低头看手机屏幕或看镜中镜头）

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，描述镜前或脚边的关联物（如脚边的宠物、拎着的购物袋）

environment_context.instruction: 描述镜子边框特征及身后的真实生活背景（如带有洗手台杂物的浴室、狭小的电梯轿厢、试衣间帘子）

name: 友人视角后置半身抓拍
description: 默认同行友人或路人用手机后置镜头拍摄的腰部以上半身照，强调非摆拍的日常瞬间。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Candid third-person snapshot taken on an iPhone rear camera, natural 26mm to 52mm focal length, eye-level perspective from across the table or nearby, waist-up half-body framing.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Unposed natural moment, subject caught mid-action, subtle smartphone portrait mode depth of field, mixed ambient restaurant or street lighting, natural skin tones, raw unretouched photo.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述角色正在进行的自然动作与神态（如低头看菜单、用吸管喝饮料、侧头看向窗外）

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，描述角色面前或手中的互动物件（如摊开的笔记本电脑、餐盘里的食物）

environment_context.instruction: 描述所处室内外场所的桌椅细节、背景虚化人群及环境光照

name: 友人视角后置全身抓拍
description: 保留较大环境纵深的后置全身抓拍，人物从头到脚完整入镜。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Full-body candid street snapshot taken on an iPhone rear camera, 26mm wide lens, eye-level standing perspective, full figure from head to shoes visible within realistic environmental depth.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Authentic everyday travel or street snapshot, natural daylight or city night neon ambient light, realistic ground shadows, slight smartphone HDR processing, unedited raw photo.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述全身动态姿势（如迈步向前走回头看、靠在栏杆上插兜站立）及完整穿搭细节

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，描述身旁的大型伴随物体（如牵着的狗、停在身后的自行车、手推行李箱）

environment_context.instruction: 描述街道、建筑、公园或景区背景纵深及天气光线状态

name: 第一人称主观视角拍物
description: 模拟角色手持手机低头俯拍或平视拍摄眼前物品、宠物或方向盘的主观视角。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: First-person POV snapshot taken on an iPhone rear camera, 45-degree downward angle or natural eye-level close-up, casual handheld framing.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Natural ambient shadows, realistic surface micro-textures, slightly imperfect smartphone focus, everyday authentic documentary snapshot, raw mobile camera color science, unedited.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述画面核心拍摄的物体或宠物状态（如蜷缩在毛毯上睡觉的橘猫、吃到一半的拉面碗、握着方向盘的视角）

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，仅描述画面边缘露出的角色手部动作、袖口或俯拍鞋尖（严禁出现人脸描述）

environment_context.instruction: 描述物体所在的接触面材质（如木质餐桌、床单、汽车中控台）及局部环境光

name: 随手拍环境与风景空镜
description: 纯环境、天气、建筑或交通状况的随手记录，人物完全不入镜。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Casual handheld smartphone photo of scenery, iPhone rear camera 26mm wide shot, authentic unedited street or window view.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Realistic smartphone HDR dynamic range, natural weather lighting, slight lens flare or glass window reflection if indoors, everyday documentary feel, zero post-processing.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述核心景物、天气现象或特定建筑地标（如暴雨中的十字路口尾灯、晚霞下的写字楼天际线）

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，描述前景物理遮挡物以增强现场代入感（如带雨滴的车前挡风玻璃与雨刮器、阳台铁艺栏杆）

environment_context.instruction: 描述时间段、天空色调、能见度及整体氛围
